name: app-scope-of-work-sprint-timeline-in-light-grey
title: Scope-of-work slide with stepped sprint pills and task lists descending to the right
whatItIs: A light grey slide with '01', 'Scope of work', a short paragraph and four stepped sprint capsules (Research, Strategy, UI Design, Delivery) each with an icon in a white circle, faint tick lines and a short list of tasks under a bold title, descending diagonally.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; the staircase shows progress without clutter.
techniques: Use pills with an icon circle as phase labels.
List tasks as plain lines with a thin vertical rule.
Keep the palette to grey and black.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule labelling a phase with an icon.
Dotted lines fading at the ends of a pill.
Short lines under a phase title.
